ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels in the lobe centers and 15% low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the interior of both lobes. A thick, low-intensity black band follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A distinctive vertical column of horizontal black bars (ladder pattern) is positioned at the central midline extending from the notch toward the water line. Minor black streaks extend from the trailing edge into the white area of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is significant, creating a distinct separation of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration. The trailing edge displays a jagged sawtooth profile with numerous sharp peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced on the left lobe's upper boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges from the notch to the tips, terminating in sharp, upwardly swept distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular bumps (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of short, unaligned vertical black linear marks (scratches) are visible on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe's interior. Sparse tan-colored circular spots are visible on the mid-lower surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified/parasitic clusters localized at both fluke tips; potential minor tissue loss or irregular growth at the extreme right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique vertical 'ladder' pigmentation pattern along the central axis, consisting of a series of stacked horizontal black bars.
